reason: Each hero's selected GLB mesh, walking GLB, and running GLB use the same 24 bone names, parent hierarchy, and bind transforms.

validation.hips: direct bone target; animated local hip motion retained
validation.head: direct bone target; no remap
validation.knees: LeftLeg and RightLeg direct targets; no remap
validation.scale: uniform runtime normalization from imported visible bounds to locked gameplay height
validation.facing: positive uniform scale with Y-axis rotation; negative skeleton scale forbidden

fbxAlternateExportPolicy.reason: The FBX walking files are alternate exports of the same named walking takes already present in compatible GLB form. Their Blender-normalized bind matrices differ by container coordinate conversion, so duplicating them would add no unique motion and would require unnecessary axis retargeting.
